Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nitin - 29 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Pallavi - 32 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Neeta - 57 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Nitin stands on the training ground. Pallavi and Neeta stand near him.]

Neeta: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nitin draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Nitin (laughing): "And then?"

[Nitin mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Neeta: "Yes, of course."

[Nitin swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Nitin (happily): "Careful!"

[Nitin shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Pallavi: "What happened?"

[Pallavi rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Nitin: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The royal court - Day

[Nitin stands in the court. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "So, here we are!"

[Nitin sits down on the throne.]

Pallavi: "Okay."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Nitin: "What a nice place."

[Nitin pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Nitin: "That's easy."

[Nitin drinks a beer.]

Neeta: "Really?"

[Nitin staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Nitin (gently): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
